title: An Information-Flow Perspective on Algorithmic Fairness
benchmark_measurement: Disparate treatment based on religious affiliation in a German wage tax computation program. Specifically, it checked if the 'religious affiliation' input unfairly influenced the general wage tax calculation, beyond its intended use for calculating the church tax.
religious_groups: Unspecified religious affiliation (in the context of German church tax)
findings: Using an information flow analysis tool on the official German wage tax computation software (Java code from 2015-2023), the study found no disparate treatment based on religious affiliation. The 'religious affiliation' input was found to not influence the main wage tax computation, only the separate church tax calculation as intended.
